name: EverOS
description: Gives agents a local-first memory layer that stores conversations, files and trajectories as Markdown, indexes them in SQLite and LanceDB, and serves recall over a local REST API.

skills.name: Memory REST API
skills.description: Adds, flushes and searches memories over the local /api/v2 HTTP server started with everos server start, using keyword or hybrid search.

skills.name: Markdown Source of Truth
skills.description: Stores memory as editable, Git-versionable Markdown files, and a cascade watcher syncs edits into the SQLite and LanceDB indexes.

skills.name: Knowledge Wiki
skills.description: Maintains editable, source-backed Markdown knowledge pages with a taxonomy, CRUD APIs and topic search alongside episodic memory.

skills.name: Offline Reflection
skills.description: Merges episode clusters and refines user profiles and agent skills between sessions so stored memory improves over time.
